about: Front ID0: findings of the id lint (src/i18n/lint/, profile id) that are correct Indonesian in one string, each with a reason. Keys are the lint's string ids; `words` are the matched words allowed in that string only, `rules` whole rules, `placeholders` added placeholders.

original:fragment|Meter Radio Telescope.reason: radioIdCaptionText places VIREO’s telescope diameter where the translation holds {diameter} (Indonesian puts the number after «Teleskop Radio»), as Spanish, Portuguese and French do

original:\" Not Found..reason: VIREO joins a straight opening quote, the search text and this tail (helpNotFoundText, the radio hot list and saved-rows Find); the closing quote must match that untranslated opening one

original:fragment|You have not recorded.reason: VIREO closes this quote with its untranslated tail ’".’ (PHOTOMETER_RECORD_PIECES.movedTail); the opening quote must match it

map:camera.citationIr.reason: the proper names Two Micron All Sky Survey and University of Massachusetts, kept in English as cited

original:Virtual Observatory mode is ena.reason: VIREO's option names keep their capitals: «Mode Observatorium Virtual» names the Virtual Observatory mode, as the message quotes “Observatorium Virtual” and “Mode Edit” after it
